Régulation température cabine

Panel or system regulating passenger-cabin temperature by mixing conditioned bleed air and recirculated flow.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Régulation température cabine?

In this glossary, Régulation température cabine refers to: Panel or system regulating passenger-cabin temperature by mixing conditioned bleed air and recirculated flow.

How is Régulation température cabine used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sol, la régulation température cabine zone 2 bloquée à 30 °C ; demandons réinitialisation maintenance avant reprise embarquement."

Definition

Panel or system regulating passenger-cabin temperature by mixing conditioned bleed air and recirculated flow.

Operational example

Ground, cabin temperature control for zone two locked at thirty degrees; request maintenance reset before passenger boarding resumes to avoid discomfort.

Localized term

Régulation température cabine

Localized example
